name: Text to sound effects
summary: Generate multiple seeded WAV sound effects (with MP3 copies) from a text prompt using Hugging Face diffusion audio models.
help: Pick a model, describe the sound and set the number of takes and their length. Each take is a WAV file with an MP3 copy, plus a CSV and JSON manifest. Runs on whatever machine is available: on an NVIDIA GPU in seconds per take; without one, on the CPU (8 threads, 50 steps, one candidate), about a minute per take for AudioLDM and several for AudioLDM 2 or Stable Audio. AudioLDM and AudioLDM 2 can make several candidates per take and keep the one that best matches the prompt (CLAP ranking): Candidates 0 = 3 on a GPU, 1 on a CPU. Stable Audio Open is gated: accept its licence on Hugging Face and save your token in Profile > Keys (or in this block). AudioLDM lengths are capped at 10 s, Stable Audio at 47 s. Model licences may restrict commercial use.

params.label: Sound description
params.default: A sudden powerful thunderclap directly overhead, followed by a long low rolling rumble that slowly fades into a quiet rainstorm. Photorealistic field recording, no music, no voices.

params.label: Inference steps (0=automatic)
params.help: 0: AudioLDM 100, AudioLDM 2 150, Stable Audio 100 on a GPU; 50 on a CPU

params.label: Candidates per take (0=automatic)
params.help: AudioLDM / AudioLDM 2 make this many and keep the one closest to the prompt (CLAP). 0: 3 on a GPU, 1 on a CPU

params.label: Hugging Face token
params.help: Empty: the Hugging Face token in the profile of whoever runs the flow. Needed for gated models (Stable Audio Open)

params.label: Generate requested by Studio (View only)
params.help: Leave off. The View enables this only when Generate sounds is clicked; a normal Blueprint Run does not start inference.
